runtime.shell_isolation: OpenCode and its managed V1 plugin run in a bubblewrap workspace that hides host home, repository, temporary paths and grader sources. The model shell is launched through an evaluation-owned Landlock+seccomp wrapper with workspace-scoped writes and denied socket/network syscalls. Anvil Analytics tools are denied; the managed plugin dependency is preseeded from the pinned, read-only local cache. The OpenCode process retains provider network access. No HTTP(S) proxy variables were present in the host environment. A failed preflight stops before model execution.

resource_budget.monetary_cost_observability: The smoke stream emitted a numeric cost telemetry value of 0, but its meaning as actual billing is unverified. Report event telemetry separately; monetary cost remains NOT MEASURED.

stop_conditions: Provider quota, billing, authentication, or rate-limit error
Runtime/model/variant differs from the selected values
Sandbox or hidden-grader isolation check fails
Per-invocation time, output, or global wall budget is reached
Any unexpected access to host secrets or protected evaluation data
A challenge would require external services or production resources
Unclassified terminal OpenCode error before any tool or token event; stop the sequence rather than repeat or infer a cause
cost_claims: No cost claim will be made when the provider does not report cost.
